Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
Well here is a serpentis weenie deck, I think it would need some pool gain, but not sure what to put there... basic idea is you bring your biggest guy out first who starts bringing out more people cheap with mesu bedshets, you get superior serpentis on your guys asap so they can fight properly, stealth bleed with basic eternal mask + basic revelation of desire, get out couple aabbts for defense who will get a sport bike and then just block your predators stuff. Combat is sort of like poor mans trapparition with skin of the adders for prevent and extra damage, grasp the pythons (to vitals, teehee) and dead end alleys for presses, tongue of the serpents to wear down prevent heavy people and to regain blood.

Looks far too complicated and weak.  Looks quite slow. Besise, you have only 3 "top" vampires, drawing them in the initial crypt is not guaranteed They stay weak in the meantime The best part of the deck. Too sad you have no card to put corruption counters So you'll play 2 pool for a blocker that does nothing else? (and a crypt card)? Better play some Set's Curse Looks weak but you may give it a try.
